title: Cross-Attentive Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2604.16657v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of frozen language models, but most PEFT methods remain deterministic or unimodal, limiting their reliability in low-resource audio-text settings where uncertainty depends on both linguistic evidence and acoustic conditions. We introduce SPECTRA (Stochastic Posterior Estimation with Cross-modal Token-level Rank Adaptation), a multimodal Bayesian low-rank adaptation framework for uncertainty-aware audio-text learning. SPECTRA keeps the text and audio backbones frozen and confines stochasticity to a compact rank-$r$ latent matrix inside each LoRA adapter. At each transformer layer, text-derived low-rank token features query frame-level audio embeddings through lightweight cross-attention; the resulting token-specific acoustic context parameterizes the mean and variance of an amortized variational posterior over the adapter latent. translated_title: 面向多模态不确定性估计的跨注意力贝叶斯低秩适应
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调（PEFT）能够对冻结的语言模型进行高效适配，但大多数PEFT方法仍然是确定性的或单模态的，这限制了它们在低资源音频-文本场景中的可靠性，因为在这些场景中，不确定性既取决于语言证据，也取决于声学条件。我们提出了SPECTRA（基于跨模态词元级秩适应的随机后验估计），这是一个面向不确定性感知音频-文本学习的多模态贝叶斯低秩适应框架。SPECTRA保持文本和音频骨干网络冻结，并将随机性限制在每个LoRA适配器内部的紧凑秩-r潜在矩阵中。在每个Transformer层，由文本导出的低秩词元特征通过轻量级交叉注意力查询帧级音频嵌入；由此产生的词元特定声学上下文对适配器潜在变量上摊销变分后验的均值和方差进行参数化。因此，音频不仅仅是作为一种……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了SPECTRA——一种多模态贝叶斯低秩适应框架，通过跨模态词元级交叉注意力让音频声学上下文参数化LoRA适配器潜在变量的摊销变分后验，从而在低资源音频-文本学习中实现不确定性感知的高效微调。
en_tdlr: SPECTRA, a multimodal Bayesian low-rank adaptation framework that uses cross-modal token-level cross-attention to let acoustic context parameterize an amortized variational posterior over LoRA latent matrices, enabling uncertainty-aware, parameter-efficient fine-tuning for low-resource audio-text learning.
